title: Lulu Cloudflare usage
description: Cloudflare Analytics usage scoped to Lulu. Gauges are window totals or storage maxima, not counters; never rate/increase/sum snapshots. Not invoice totals. S3 provider unconfirmed, so R2 is excluded. Logs written-event metering is not included. Mac credential availability is shown explicitly.

list.name: window
list.label: Usage window
list.query: Rolling 24 hours : trailing_24h,Previous complete UTC day : previous_day

panels.title: Credential source available
panels.description: 1 means the latest SSH/1Password collection completed, 0 means it failed. Mac reachability and 1Password authentication are required. No values means no observation. Authorization timeout stops the timer to avoid repeated desktop prompts; authorize 1Password before restarting it.

targets.expr: last_over_time(lulu_cf_exporter_success[2d])

panels.title: Oldest dataset age
panels.description: Time since the oldest last successful dataset query. Collection every 15 minutes; investigate over 30 minutes. No alerts are installed.

targets.expr: time() - min(last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_timestamp{cf_window="$window"}[2d]))

panels.title: Dataset query success
panels.description: 1 successful API query, 0 failed API query. A successful query can still return no resource rows.

targets.expr: last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m])

panels.title: Resource observations present
panels.description: 0 means no row returned, not measured zero usage. Old usage points are suppressed when this observation is 0.

targets.expr: last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m])

panels.title: Worker requests and errors
panels.description: Cloudflare Analytics estimates. Errors are not HTTP 5xx. Both series refer to the selected window, not cumulative counters.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(lulu_cf_worker_requests{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

(last_over_time(lulu_cf_worker_errors{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

panels.title: Worker CPU
panels.description: cpuTimeUs converted to seconds; isolate startup CPU is not included.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(lulu_cf_worker_cpu_seconds{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

(last_over_time(lulu_cf_do_requests{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

(last_over_time(lulu_cf_do_errors{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

panels.title: DO duration (GB-s)
panels.description: Already weighted by configured memory. Do not multiply by memory again. Not billed currency.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(lulu_cf_do_duration_gb_seconds{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

(last_over_time(lulu_cf_do_active_seconds{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

(last_over_time(lulu_cf_do_cpu_seconds{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

(last_over_time(lulu_cf_do_rows_read{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

(last_over_time(lulu_cf_do_rows_written{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

panels.title: SQLite storage: window maximum
panels.description: Maximum observed storage in the selected window; not current storage, an account sum, or GB-month.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(lulu_cf_do_storage_max_bytes{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

panels.title: KV operations
panels.description: Scoped to LULU_MCP. Missing action rows are unknown, not assumed zero.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(lulu_cf_kv_operations{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

panels.title: KV storage: window maximum
panels.description: The baseline returned 0 bytes despite read traffic. This is the API observation, not proof the namespace is empty.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(lulu_cf_kv_storage_max_bytes{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

(last_over_time(lulu_cf_kv_storage_max_keys{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_collection_success{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)) and on (cf_dataset, cf_window, cf_resource, cf_operation) (last_over_time(lulu_cf_data_present{cf_window="$window"}[45m]) == 1)

panels.title: Adaptive sample interval
panels.description: API aggregation is already extrapolated. Never multiply usage by this value. Sample interval is not a confidence interval. Storage datasets do not expose this field.

targets.expr: last_over_time(lulu_cf_sample_interval{cf_window="$window"}[45m])
max(last_over_time(lulu_cf_window_start_timestamp{cf_window="$window"}[45m])) * 1000
max(last_over_time(lulu_cf_window_end_timestamp{cf_window="$window"}[45m])) * 1000
